# Routes

Useful routes include the canal cycle path, Mum's journey to the clinic and the flat walk from the museum to the bus stop. Record steep kerbs, steps and places to rest. Distances alone hide who can use a route. A temporary diversion needs a review date, otherwise my helpful warning can outlive the obstruction.

Keep a short version for a day with little energy, a shaded option for heat and a way to turn back after starting. A route that leaves me able to do something afterwards may be better than a shorter one that leaves me shaken. [[Care arrangements]] links to the clinic journey; its timetable should be checked against the actual service before a visit.
